result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is a clearly broken promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card and an inconsistent favorite-button style. A few minor visual inconsistencies also appear in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which is a meaningless/zero-value promotion and looks like a data or formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or render the actual discount percentage if one exists.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/transparent circle with a white outline heart, creating an inconsistent look and weaker contrast on the second.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button treatment (e.g., white circle with dark heart plus a subtle shadow) across all cards to ensure uniformity and adequate contrast on any image.

issues.description: The first thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light, washed-out background while the sibling cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually uneven and the '15–25 min' badge blend into the image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (e.g., apply a consistent gradient overlay) so time badges remain legible and cards look cohesive.
